heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly sunny southeast, otherwise sun filtering through gradually increasing high clouds. High temperatures in the upper 60s to lower 70s. South winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy south. Partly to mostly cloudy north, with the slight chance of a shower from the northern Greens westward. Lows mainly in the 50s, with some upper 40s in the cooler hollows, and some lower 60s in the Champlain Valley. South winds around 5 mph in areas east of the Greens, 5 to 10 mph in the west, and gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Wednesday
text: Partly cloudy. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s, mid to upper 70s southeast, and in the broad valleys west. Winds from the south at 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph in the Champlain Valley.
